title: 36 Hours in Sydney
abstract: With its place on the world stage firmly set, this Australian city seems to be in the midst of a historical revival.

title: 36 Hours in Munich
abstract: The Bavarian capital boasts dance clubs, science and art museums and, yes, beer gardens.

title: 36 Hours in Kyoto, Japan
abstract: This ancient city is electrified by the breathtakingly new, from geishas gliding down a lane in Gion to a minimalist gallery and cafe.

title: 36 Hours in Beirut
abstract: From the red-hot night-life district to Lebanon’s first contemporary art museum, the Paris of the Middle East is luring ever more travelers.
